products.title: Mochila Softee Atlas Elegant - Softee
products.description:
SOFTEE ATLAS ELEGANT BACKPACK - Discover this elegant padel backpack. With the necessary space for paddle tennis rackets.  

The SOFTEE ATLAS ELEGANT BACKPACK is a comfortable and very easy to carry backpack, which makes it functional for everyone. In it we see a careful and elegant design, in cream color. The finish of the backpack is leatherette, being very soft and giving it a Premium touch.

It has a large main compartment, ideal for sports clothing, towels and accessories, offering a well-used space that is easy to organize. It also incorporates a specific compartment for the racket, which allows it to be transported safely and separately from the rest of the material.

At the bottom there is a separate compartment for shoes. This is located on the side. It is a perfect option to keep footwear insulated.

products.title: Star Vie Helion 2024 - Star Vie
products.description:
STAR VIE HELION 2024 - Look for maximum precision on the track with the new Helion model. High control racket, round in shape and medium-low balance to achieve a defense game of 10. INTRODUCTION OF THE RACKET

STAR VIE HELION 2024, is the name of this racket. A new 2024 season model, which is intended for a control-based game. Its round shape and good comfort make it an ideal option for an intermediate level player.

PLAYER TYPE

This padel racket is highly recommended for a medium level player who plays in the defense zone.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

We are going to analyze the characteristics of the STAR VIE HELION 2024, a padel racket designed to give you a perfect game from the defense zone, as it provides softness in hitting to increase control. It is made with Star Vie's Ultra Speed ​​Soft rubber, which is the softest rubber available in the brand.

Internally it has a hybrid composition in the tubular that combines carbon fiber and fiberglass. On the other hand, the planes are made of 100% fiberglass, but of different densities, which improves ball output and also durability.

It is a product 100% manufactured in Spain, specifically in the city of Guadalajara.

PLAY STYLE

If you are looking for a racket with which to dominate, this is one of the best padel rackets from the Spanish firm that you will be able to have. The STAR VIE HELION 2024 is a sure success in defense, also allowing a good attack.

products.title: Nexus Rangiroa Cap - Caps
products.description:
NEXUS RANGIROA CAP - An elegant model to wear both on and off the court. This spectacular NEXUS RANGIROA CAP is the perfect complement for our outdoor matches, preventing the sun from bothering us, but also in our indoor matches, preventing sweat from getting into our eyes.

Its microperforated fabric facilitates ventilation and comfort while we play.

products.title: Head Extreme Elite - Head
products.description:
HEAD EXTREME ELITE - An intermediate range racket with the latest technology from Head Padel. Get better in the attack zone with it in your hands. Made with a new diamond mold. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

We analyze the HEAD EXTREME ELITE, the little sister of the Extreme series, but the bravest in terms of colors in its design, with a fluorine yellow aesthetic that attracts attention wherever it goes. Same diamond shape, high balance and power as the rest of the Head Extreme rackets, but with variety in its composition.

PLAYER TYPE

Recommended for padel players with an intermediate or advanced level. It is an attacking racket for backhand players who want to attack on each point.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The most important construction data of the HEAD EXTREME ELITE are:

- Carbon fiber on the frame for high durability.

- The planes are made of the best fiberglass that the Head brand has. It provides us with the necessary durability and comfort for a high ball output with little effort.

- Power Foam rubber inner core. It does not transmit any vibration to the player during the game.

- AUXETIC technology for the best experience that technology in a racket can give you. It adapts to every moment of the game.

- New Soft Buttcap technology, which is a new white cap on the handle that reduces vibrations. This one is orange.

PLAY STYLE

On the court, this new HEAD EXTREME ELITE is a powerful racket with good control thanks to its absorbent materials, such as fiberglass and power foam rubber. It will give us better solvency in attacking shots than in defense.

products.title: Nexus Firefight - Nexus
products.description:
NEXUS FIREFIGHT - A teardrop-shaped carbon power racket. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL 

The NEXUS FIREFIGHT is a racket with which your game can shine due to its great power. With a great ball feel, this racket is perfect for all types of intermediate level players, being able to adapt to the conditions of the match at all times.

PLAYER TYPE 

Racquet specially designed for players looking to handle the blow without losing power in each of their blows. Intermediate level.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE 

This racket is characterized by its 3K carbon that provides durability and resistance. Its teardrop/diamond shape helps you have extra power with a more controlled game in the defensive phases of the game. 

Its smooth gloss finish makes its color stand out. Aesthetically it has a modern and striking design. Features a combination of glossy black with neon yellow and white details

PLAY STYLE

The NEXUS FIREFIGHT is designed for a balanced playstyle, albeit with a bias towards power.

products.title: Special Pack Mystica Legacy Carbon Hybrid Blue 2024 - Mystica
products.description:
SPECIAL PACK MYSTICA LEGACY CARBON HYBRID BLUE 2024 - Hybrid format padel racket, and with 3K carbon fiber. This model at a very good price with racket bag, overgrips, ball and protector. SPECIAL PACK MYSTICA LEGACY CARBON HYBRID BLUE 2024, a very special pack for padel players looking for a hybrid format and several essential accessories for our matches.

The pack consists of:

1 racket bag with a central compartment and another for the padel racket, 10 overgrips, 1 rough protector and 1 can of high-end padel balls.

products.title: Head Motion Pro Padel Men Bbfc - Head
products.description:
HEAD MOTION PRO PADEL MEN BBFC - Some more striking padel shoes, combining navy blue and red. High-end professional, with a very grippy sole. INTRODUCTION OF THE SNEAKERS

The HEAD MOTION PRO PADEL MEN BBFC are the high-end Head shoes for the 2024 season. This new Motion Range has several models, and these are the top ones. Designed with a beautiful combination of navy and red tones.

PLAYER TYPE

Recommended for competitive players. They are not basic sneakers. If we want to take advantage of it, we will have to be demanding, play and compete.

MOST IMPORTANT CONSTRUCTION DATA

These Head padel shoes are a model that incorporates innovative technologies. For these models they add a new type of sole with a unique pattern. It is similar to clay.

For greater comfort, it incorporates Dynafoam technology, air cells that absorb vibrations and improve the sensations underfoot.

Made with breathable mesh fabric almost throughout the entire shoe, except in the most delicate areas that have several reinforcements. This mesh fabric improves flexibility and comfort when we use them.
